Who We Are

Family-run.
Owner-operated.

Jon and Will Meunier started J&W Windows because they saw what happens when service businesses get too big — quality slips and the owners disappear. So at J&W, one of them is on every single job.

Over 30 jobs in, they still show up in person, do the work, and stand behind it.
